_note: A name declared twice in one template scope: two top-level snippets, an each item and its index (the compiler declares the index from a bare name, so the error has no position: 0:0), an each item or await value and a {@const} in the same block (the await value is declared after its branch is walked, so the error points at the value), a component's let: directive and a {@const}. D04 shows var redeclarations and a {@const} shadowing a script variable stay valid. Verified against upstream svelte-check.
